title: EvidenceReference
description: A pointer to a specific source that supports a claim within the Finance X platform. All claims in analysis outputs must carry at least one evidence reference.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence reference (UUID).

source_type.description: Category of the source document or data.

source_id.description: Identifier of the source system or feed (e.g. 'KAP', 'BIST_MDP', 'TUIK').

document_id.description: Unique identifier of the specific document within the source system.

document_title.description: Human-readable title of the source document.

page_ref.description: Page number, section, or paragraph within the document. E.g. 'page 47', 'Note 12', 'Section 3.2'.

quote_or_excerpt.description: Direct quote or relevant excerpt from the source that supports the claim. Required for KAP disclosures and financial statement line items.

timestamp.description: Publication or disclosure timestamp of the source document (ISO 8601).

retrieved_at.description: When the Finance X platform ingested or retrieved this document.

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period the evidence relates to, if applicable. E.g. '2024Q3', '2023FY', '2024H1'.

data_quality_score.description: Quality score assigned by the Reconciliation Agent (0=unusable, 1=fully verified). Scores below 0.5 must trigger a warning.

parser_confidence.description: Confidence of the Parse & Standardization Agent in the accuracy of data extraction from this document.

company_ticker.description: BIST ticker symbol of the company this evidence pertains to. E.g. 'ASELS', 'EREGL'.

is_audited.description: Whether the underlying financial data has been audited by an independent auditor.

auditor.description: Name of the independent auditor, if applicable.
